server.name: com.geospatialsystem/location-profile

server.title: Geospatial System — Location Profile

headers.description: Bearer token: 'Bearer ' followed by your Geospatial System API key (starts with grk_). Free trial keys at https://api.geospatialsystem.com
headers.name: Authorization

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.audience: Real estate and property-information professionals, insurance & risk analysts, asset managers, disaster & emergency management teams
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.coverage: NASA SRTM worldwide (~30 m); USGS CONUS NED (~10 m); Geoscience Australia DTM (5 m, ~80% populated areas); LINZ New Zealand DTM (5 m, >95% populated areas)
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: Free trial key (no credit card) unlocks elevation queries and dataset catalogue; Pro keys unlock all tools at volume
